description: Parse an .xlsx workbook (or a .csv/.tsv file, read as one sheet) in one call and return its full semantic NDJSON: one JSON record per line (workbook_meta, sheet, cell, edge, image, image_summary, audit), covering every cell's value and formula and the formula dependency edges. Use it to read a whole file without opening a session; large files are handed to an async job and awaited for you. To start a parse without waiting, use submit_job; to read a few cells or edit, use create_session; to compare two files, use diff_workbooks. Pass exactly one of path, url or base64 (up to 20 MB). The file is uploaded to the Basis API, and each call counts against the API key's parse quota (quota_exceeded once it is used up). webhook_url, if set, also gets an HMAC-signed POST when the parse finishes.

path.description: Local filesystem path to an .xlsx or .csv file (read on this machine, then uploaded)

url.description: URL to fetch the .xlsx or .csv file from

webhook_url.description: https URL that gets an HMAC-signed POST with the job's status when the parse finishes

name: parse_workbook
title: Parse workbook
